description: Create or update a customer-scoped EveryAILaw Pro jurisdiction and role profile. A profile is filtering input, not a legal applicability determination.

idempotency_key.description: Stable retry key required when creating a profile. Reuse it after an uncertain response.

profile_id.description: Existing profile ID to update. Omit to create a profile.

roles.description: EveryAILaw role slugs. An empty list means all roles in the saved jurisdictions.

name: save_profile
